effects.true: Known malware and phishing domains are blocked using uBlock Origin's default lists. This build has no Chromium Safe Browsing, so it is weaker than Chrome's protection. Always on.

effects.\"allow\": Allowed. Most compatible, but ad networks can follow you across sites.
effects.\"block_incognito\": Blocked in private windows only. Normal windows still allow them.
effects.\"block\": Blocked everywhere. Stops most cross-site tracking; a few embedded logins or payment widgets may break.

effects.false: Cookies are kept, so you stay logged in to sites between sessions.
effects.true: All cookies and site data are deleted when you close the browser. You log in again every time.

effects.\"default\": Chromium's standard isolation of third-party storage.
effects.\"strict\": Strictest third-party storage isolation Chromium offers. Exact extra effect over the default is not yet verified.

effects.\"default\": Sites see the page you came from, as normal.
effects.\"trim_cross_origin\": Other sites only see your origin, not the full address. Needs restart.
effects.\"origin_only_cross_origin\": Other sites only see the site name. Needs restart.
effects.\"none_cross_origin\": Other sites get no referrer at all. Some sites that check it will break. Needs restart.
effects.trim_cross_origin: Chromium's standard: other sites only see your site name, not the full address of the page you came from.
effects.none_cross_origin: Other sites get no referrer at all. Some sites that check it (logins, downloads, embedded media) will break. Needs restart.

effects.\"basic\": Adds tiny random noise to canvas and audio readouts so sites cannot build a stable fingerprint from them. Needs restart.
effects.\"strong\": Basic protection plus noise on layout and text measurements and fewer browser details exposed. Some sites may look slightly off. Cannot make you anonymous. Needs restart.
effects.strong: Basic protection plus noise on layout and text measurements, fewer browser details exposed, and your computer reports a fixed small number of CPU cores. Some sites may look slightly off. Cannot make you anonymous. Needs restart.

effects.\"ask\": Sites may ask for permissions as normal.
effects.\"ask_restricted\": Sites must ask, and intrusive prompts like notifications are limited.
effects.\"block\": Sensitive permissions are blocked by default. Allow them per site if needed.

effects.\"reduced\": Fewer background tasks while the browser is idle.
effects.\"minimal\": Browser does not run in the background after you close it, and background tasks are cut to the minimum.

effects.true: Pages may be loaded before you click, which is faster but contacts sites you did not visit.
effects.false: Pages are not loaded until you open them.

effects.\"default\": Normal WebRTC behavior; calls can reveal your local network addresses.
effects.\"public_only\": WebRTC only uses your public connection, hiding local addresses. Video calls still work.
effects.\"proxy_only\": WebRTC only works through a proxy. Calls may fail without one.

effects.\"off\": Plain HTTP is allowed without a warning.
effects.\"first\": Tries HTTPS first and warns before falling back to HTTP.
effects.\"strict\": Only HTTPS. Plain HTTP sites need a manual exception.

effects.false: Off. Optional usage and diagnostic reporting is disabled in every mode.

usability.name: Prioritize usability
usability.tagline: Ad blocking with the fewest broken sites.
usability.tradeoff: Least protection against cross-site tracking and fingerprinting.

medium.name: Medium privacy
medium.tagline: Recommended. Strong privacy that rarely breaks sites.
medium.tradeoff: A few embedded widgets may need an exception.

maximum.name: Maximum privacy
maximum.tagline: Strictest settings this browser can enforce.
maximum.tradeoff: Cookies are deleted on close, so you log in each time; some sites will break.

note: All modes include uBlock Origin with its default settings. Not a promise of anonymity.
